usage.purpose: Bounded account quota snapshots and an optional Copilot-only composer usage control
usage.risk: Account billing-cycle usage is not context occupancy or session credits. Use canonical Host-only OAuth through public credentials and a separate strict namespace. No secondary credential owner, guessed enterprise endpoint, redirected credential, provider raw error, general model wire or Core patch. Validate amounts and units; pooled credits_used has no individual denominator, legacy requests are not AI credits, percentage-only data does not prove precise remaining units. Missing data is unavailable, not zero or unlimited. Bound network/cache/failure behavior and guard account continuity across asynchronous work, cached reads, invalidation and disposal. Add only a session-scoped public composer dock contribution; no private DOM/store injection or global-default inference for existing Sessions. Per-session credit accounting stays unavailable until complete attributable receipts are exposed by supported unchanged public APIs. Synthetic endpoint/UI evidence does not establish real quota permissions, billing latency or live Desktop activation.

authorization.purpose: OAuth lifecycle, grant normalization and read-only live migration readiness
authorization.risk: Managed model HTTP 401 retires only an exact current token proof without replay. The next independent caller may renew through native Models.getAuth and serialized credentials.modifyRecord; temporary expiry projections are never stored. Separate per-account recovery cooldown survives metadata invalidation, applies even to force discovery, and rejects identical-token renewal. Late generations, cancellation, 403 and message text alone cannot retire newer sign-ins; HTTP-only observation does not claim WebSocket recovery. status and describeGitHubCopilotProviderProfile are read-only; reconcile is an explicit stored-snapshot settings write, not OAuth refresh or capability proof. Opening Models separately calls non-forcing ensureModels once for missing/idle/stale/error/loading signed-in metadata; fresh ready cache needs no request. Explicit successful Start sign-in/account switch forces discovery once. Background credential/reset events clear Client state and read status without forcing discovery on every token event; next open/use ensures metadata. Manual Refresh lives in Manage and errors offer Retry. Configured credentials and discovered metadata do not prove transport readiness. No-arg migrationStatus is a separate eighth strict Remote (seven ordinary auth methods/codec unchanged): loaded plugin version constant, protocol1, live capability/completeness flags, pending->request-header->genuinely-empty default selections and effective-native/registry flags. It invokes no auth status/discovery, credentials/network or writes. historyScope live-agents-only excludes cold histories; running activeRequestSelection is latest recorded header, not proven in-flight LLM. Require operator cold-history acknowledgement, complete evidence and immediate pre-CAS recheck; version/capabilities are structural self-reports, not full Desktop/Core byte attestation or atomic cross-namespace proof. Planned Ops maintenance is config-only v1, with no automated Session/default writes, install or restart.

models.purpose: Shared account/many models, independent Sessions, reviewed route migration and opt-in dedicated planner/executor roles
models.risk: Managed compaction budgets preserve truthful context/input/output capacities, caller caps and already resolved effort. Native admission uses owned numeric failures; optional early pressure requires exact initiating Session/header, marked loop request and enabled stock recovery. No silent truncation, hidden chunking, new retry loop or automatic model switch. Oversized manual summaries remain explicit failures, not claimed recovery. Model-role settings are profile-global; Save never requires a workspace. Explicit dedicated-session creation uses only current public Client membership (legacy current or alpha.2 byId retainedBy.mainView), never a first/recent fallback. Missing/ambiguous navigation disables fresh creation only. Keep a stable traced Remote per registration and preserve uncertain request UUID/workspace/revision across navigation and surface remounts; do not enroll ordinary or existing sessions. Default accountModelTtlMs is 86400000 (24h maximum reuse), accountModelFailureCooldownMs is 300000 (5min), configurable under github-copilot. Before new leases, a reusable warm snapshot with at most 330000ms of stored-token validity is retired; native getAuth uses that same explicit minimum in the existing single-flight auth phase, before fresh metadata/proof. Never cancel an already active discovery flight merely for this readiness check or force past cooldown. Short renewed tokens fail early; old prepared calls and search continuity still fail closed on later proof changes, with no automatic wire replay. Updated UI time is metadata time, not OAuth refresh time. Cold Chat picker and /model listModels ensure the shared account source without Settings first. One global account supplies many models; selected/history-backed Sessions keep their own model context. Public session.selectModel also saves a future global default, so do not promise immutable unselected empty Sessions. Code does not auto-migrate native profiles; after release the operator resolves approved Session/default choices separately, while config-only v1 Ops performs no selection writes and may CAS-remove only a reviewed user-native path with no base/journal conflicts, fresh migrationStatus evidence and registry readback. Cold history is outside that evidence and requires operator acknowledgement. Search allowlist edits remain explicit, never silently broadened. Non-forcing ensureModels on open/use shares one Host flight without periodic metadata polling; the mounted timestamp has a separate display-only 60s timer. Initial ensure includes error (reopen may retry after shared cooldown, no same-mount loops) and loading (join existing Host flight to observe completion, no extra network). Fresh ready does not fetch; true unavailable with empty models does not automatically retry. Same-account last metadata may display during TTL refresh/loading/error but never authorize requests; credential/account/permission invalidation or proof expiry immediately revokes evidence, and TTL never extends tokens. Definitive UNKNOWN_MODEL triggers one bounded metadata refresh without message replay/model switching; generic HTTP/network failures are not classified by guesswork. A same-ID catalog entry can still have the wrong protocol or capabilities. Stay plugin-only: use published APIs or a documented narrow alternative, never a new Core patch/service dependency. Label multiple routes honestly; share the canonical OAuth grant without duplicating general transport. Legacy, interrupted or user-edited ownership journals remain conflicts.

search.purpose: Session-native and fixed/default search routing with owner-isolated Copilot plans and exact registered-provider dispatch
search.risk: Auto-mode native search derives current-provider from the captured initiating Session's effective request-header/config or explicit GenerateOptions; fixed/fallback Copilot search preserves a nonempty explicit provider-owned searchModel override, otherwise considers at most three eligible account-owned Responses candidates in deterministic ID order, never the Chat model, future global default or another Session. Metadata is not capability proof; candidate probing is bounded and the final user query is sent once, never replayed across models. The provider-only UI saves both routing leaves in one namespace CAS, without a Copilot model/account-discovery prerequisite; capture stable traced Remote faces once per registration. Existing overrides stay read-only until an explicit separate narrow CAS reset sets searchModel to an empty string, never as a routing-save side effect. Pinned Settings/Client contract fixtures are not a real Host SettingsController Gateway write or live-search claim. Agent.options is an activation seed; installModelSelection overrides request/assembly; Core records effective Session.requestHeader().config before tools. Without proven request context traditional search is unavailable, and a pending newly selected model must not use an old header as current prompt guidance. Cache plans per owner so different-model A/B requests do not reuse/cancel one another. Actual cold managed search performs non-forcing shared metadata ensure before deriving facts; capability/probe checks remain. Without agents.currentInitiator, traditional search reports a named unavailable diagnostic; explicit marked GenerateOptions inline routes remain guarded and may be uncached. Credential notifications during initial lazy discovery cannot distinguish own token rotation from external account change through public status: fail the first search with WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE before probe/wire; only a later user/driver request retries, never automatically. Registration does not mutate the original global Web provider or broaden existing search allowlists; the routed facade mirrors public registrations for exact-id dispatch selected by the separate Models-page policy. Preserve file and reasoning/replay delegation, protocol/account gates and no implicit fallback. Public summaries are not raw reasoning input or decrypted replay. Validate effort against the actual selected model and retain Core default/off semantics. The session-search bundle routes through plugin-owned public web service composition, preserving the original official service config and native consumers. Automatic DeepSeek fallback needs no per-query approval, but must disclose cause/provider/API charges and never run after cancellation or proof invalidation; searchFallback=none disables it. Run pnpm build before the built Loader test. No private registry/prototype/Core/preset edits are allowed.

client.risk: Search routing is provider-only: one routing-namespace CAS for primary and fallback, no account status/discovery or model prerequisite, and stable traced Settings/routing Remote faces across parent renders. Retain nonempty legacy searchModel overrides and expose only a separate explicit narrow reset to automatic selection; saving providers must not reset them. Explicit successful Start sign-in/account switch forces one bounded discovery, immediate or polled. Opening Models separately non-forcing ensures missing/idle/stale/error/loading signed-in metadata once; fresh ready cache makes no request. Fake-clock browser checks advance 8 to 10 minutes without added RPC, retain timestamps during pending/error, replace them on refresh success, remove timestamp/timer on sign-out and keep 375px layout safe; Host TTL/cooldown timing belongs to unit tests, not screenshots. release.purpose: Version alignment and default immutable GitHub plus npm dual distribution
release.risk: Refs #43: supersedes the original Release-only decision at the user's request. Every new version requires both channels using the same original tgz. Recover existing assets before packing; never replace an immutable version. npm failures fail delivery, never silently skip; reconcile only exact SRI and preserve monotonically advancing channel tags using SemVer. The initial v0.4.0-alpha.18 package was published from the immutable Release bytes and its one-time token-authenticated bootstrap entry points have been removed. Registry metadata can lag a successful write; an immediate readback failure is uncertain and must never trigger another publish. Wait for visibility, then rerun the normal OIDC pipeline to reconcile the exact existing SRI and non-decreasing channel tag. Release-infrastructure-only changes reconcile existing tagged bytes without forcing an empty package version bump; runtime, packaged-script, package metadata and build-input changes still require a newer version. The normal pipeline remains OIDC-only and requires the configured Trusted Publisher. npm stage requires an existing package and is not bootstrap. Do not bypass organizational registry restrictions or treat CI as a bypass. Profile installation and interrupting restarts remain separately approved.
